scripts.dev: npm run sync:assets && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev
scripts.build: npm run sync:assets && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.verify:kanto: node -e "import('./scripts/validate-tokyo-build.mjs').then(async ({validateKantoBuild}) => { const r = await validateKantoBuild(); console.log(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2)); if (!r.passed) process.exitCode = 1; })"
scripts.verify:migrated: node -e "import('./scripts/validate-tokyo-build.mjs').then(async ({validateMigratedBuild}) => { const r = await validateMigratedBuild(); console.log(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2)); if (!r.passed) process.exitCode = 1; })"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run verify:parity && npm run verify:migrated && npm run verify:english && npm run verify:chinese && npm run verify:korean && npm run verify:portuguese && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
